source_clause: EH4.) When the AUTO function is off and available, the user s first press of the AUTO button will activate the AUTO ECO functionality.
reasoning: 驗證目標：10.4（EH4）定出 AUTO 關閉且可用時之第一次按壓啟動 AUTO ECO，單一 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：第十五軸依 R-C29 標 (10.1)；「AUTO 關閉且可用」為 spec 定義之 trigger，惟 TC 自身之步驟即可建立，依 **R-C28 第三問**落 test_procedure 而不入 pre_conditions；依 R-C34 補第十三軸排除，EMEA ICS 不補。為什麼這樣切：本節只定出第一次按壓之結果，第二、三次按壓由 10.5 各自成條。刻意略過：條文之「available」未定義其不可用之條件，故不寫入任何可用性判定（§8.4.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: climate screen 之 AUTO 狀態
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 不暴露 —— 可觀察量為 climate screen 之 AUTO 控制，非 head unit 之 comfort section
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車上無 HVAC 畫面／popup）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不補** —— ch16 十八節無 ECO HVAC 之對應節（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch10 側全無列），排除即無所依據；本組非 no-counterpart 之「已列而無對造」，而是 ch10 從未進入該表之比對範圍，理由相同：ch16 不承載此章之能力

tcs.tc_title: First AUTO press activates AUTO ECO
tcs.test_item:
EH4.) When the AUTO function is off and available, the user s first press of the AUTO button will activate the AUTO ECO functionality.

(press the AUTO button once -> The AUTO ECO functionality is activated)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the AUTO button until AUTO is off
2. Press the AUTO button once
tcs.expected_result:
1. The AUTO state is AUTO OFF
2. The AUTO ECO functionality is activated
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: §8.3 之軸拆分：`10.4`（EH4）之「When the AUTO function is off **and available**」以可用性為其前提，而 profile §3.2 第一軸（ATC／MTC）之 MTC 值使該前提不成立 —— 「(AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations)」為 `2.3`／`16.3` 之逐字括號（跨節取據 R-C29）。兩個軸值之預期結果相反且各自可失效：ATC 車上首按進入 AUTO ECO 而 MTC 車上不進入，任一側錯皆不使另一側錯。**「not shown 是否等於 not available」屬測試員於實車上之觀察，不屬條文之缺口**（97 §2.6，RD-1 第 7 問據此移除）。
tcs.test_item_authored: When the AUTO function is off and available, the user's first press of the AUTO button shall activate the AUTO ECO functionality

tcs.tc_title: Pressing AUTO does not activate AUTO ECO in an MTC configuration
tcs.test_item:
EH4.) When the AUTO function is off and available, the user s first press of the AUTO button will activate the AUTO ECO functionality.

(press the position at which the AUTO button is shown in an ATC configuration -> The AUTO ECO functionality is not activated)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The climate system is MTC (2.3)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Press the position at which the AUTO button is shown in an ATC configuration
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed and no AUTO button is shown
2. The AUTO ECO functionality is not activated
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: §8.3 之軸拆分：`10.4`（EH4）之「When the AUTO function is off **and available**」以可用性為其前提，而 profile §3.2 第一軸（ATC／MTC）之 MTC 值使該前提不成立 —— 「(AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations)」為 `2.3`／`16.3` 之逐字括號（跨節取據 R-C29）。兩個軸值之預期結果相反且各自可失效：ATC 車上首按進入 AUTO ECO 而 MTC 車上不進入，任一側錯皆不使另一側錯。**「not shown 是否等於 not available」屬測試員於實車上之觀察，不屬條文之缺口**（97 §2.6，RD-1 第 7 問據此移除）。
tcs.test_item_authored: AUTO is not shown in MTC configurations, so the first press of the AUTO button shall not activate the AUTO ECO functionality
